name: Caso 5 - Consistencia de cuotas Credito PYCCA pantalla vs documento

planSteps.description: Click 'Iniciar Sesión con Microsoft'. On the Microsoft page type 'desarrollopy@pycca.com', click 'Next', type the password 'cdPY2027!*', click 'Sign in', and click 'Yes' if a 'Stay signed in?' prompt appears
The authenticated POS dashboard is visible (cards 'Facturación', 'Entrega de Caja', 'Historial de impresión')

PRECONDITION: click 'IR' on 'Facturación'. If a red notification says 'No puede acceder a esta funcionalidad porque tiene entregas de caja pendientes', go back to the dashboard, open 'Entrega de Caja', click 'Procesar', complete the 'Autorización de Administrador' modal by typing the exact text '%21310300;432940;JAIME GABRIEL HURTADO ALVAREZ' into the 'Tarjeta de administrador' field followed by Enter (the leading '%' and the Enter are mandatory), then type '1979' in 'Clave de administrador' and click 'Confirmar'. Accept the success dialog and retry opening Facturación until it opens

load 10 articles: for each SKU (O22652, O22654, O22655, O22657, O22955, O22976, O22977, O22978, O22979, O23546) type it into the 'Buscar producto por SKU' field and press Enter; after each one set its row quantity to 3 and press Tab. If an article shows a red 'Pendiente' label, click it and fill every field (Homologacion='HOM-2026-001', Imei='359747505623812', Marca='GENERICA', Modelo='MODELO-TEST') then click 'Continuar'
Click 'Continuar' to reach the payment screen and select the 'CREDITO PYCCA' payment method

Type a cedula into the 'Cédula' field of the credit form and press Tab, then open the 'Crédito' dropdown. Try these cedulas in order until one shows a card WITHOUT a red padlock icon: 0919522151, 2450681438, 0922154976, 0923022339, 1200007126, 0925688160, 1205902859, 0916835226, 0962366118, 1203874142

PRECONDITION CHECK: report whether any cedula offered a selectable (non-padlocked) card. As of 24/09/2026 all 24 pool cedulas showed a padlocked card and the only working one (0301309787) was overdrawn (cupo $250.00, disponible $0.00, saldo $255.34). If every card is padlocked, STOP here and report the precondition as unmet

Select the usable card, then set 'Valor a pagar' to the amount shown in 'Crédito disponible' (or leave the pre-filled total if the credit covers it), and open the 'Financiamiento' dropdown selecting an option with interest, e.g. 'DIF. CON INTERESES - (3 CUOTAS)'
Capture from the screen: the per-instalment amount shown in 'Cuota', the number of instalments in the financing label, and the 'Valor a pagar'. All three must be greater than zero
Click 'Agregar' to register the credit payment
The registered payment row shows the SAME financing plan and the SAME instalment amount captured from the simulation

Cover any remaining balance with 'EFECTIVO' and click 'Continuar'. If a 'Seleccionar regalo' modal appears, choose the first product, click 'Aceptar' and cover the new balance. If a 'Recalcular financiamiento' warning appears on the credit row, click the refresh icon in its 'Acciones' column and re-select the same financing plan, then click 'Agregar'. Click 'Continuar', then 'Procesar' for each registered payment, completing the cash dialog when it appears

A 'Transacción finalizada' confirmation is shown and the instalment amount and plan in the issued document match exactly the values captured from the on-screen simulation (100% mathematical consistency)
